name: Regional Logistics Fleet Expansion Analysis
task:
Please complete the following four-stage multi-domain task.

=== Stage 1: Information Extraction ===
A regional logistics company's annual report (25 pages) contains: 6 distribution centers, 82% fleet utilization, average delivery fee $220 per route. Fleet expansion proposals: Center X ($3.5M, 12% capacity increase), Center Y ($2.2M, 8% increase), Center Z ($4.1M, 18% increase). Total capital budget: $6M.

=== Stage 2: Financial Analysis ===
Calculate NPV of the investment.

=== Stage 3: Resource Allocation ===
Optimize budget allocation.

=== Stage 4: Decision ===
Recommend the best course of action.

subtasks.name: Report data extraction and information retrieval
